## Overview

Arcee AI: Trinity Large Thinking is a standard-tier AI model developed by Arcee-ai, released on January 1, 2024. This model is not open-source and is designed to provide large thinking capabilities for various applications. The architecture of Arcee AI: Trinity Large Thinking is not explicitly stated, but its capabilities and benchmarks suggest a robust and versatile model. With a context window of 262,144 tokens and a maximum output of 262,144 tokens, this model is well-suited for tasks that require extensive text processing and generation.
